title: On a posteriori stopping rules of adaptive stochastic heavy ball method for ill-posed problems
summary: In this paper we develop a stochastic heavy ball method for solving ill-posed inverse problems. The method updates the iterate using only a randomly selected equation at each iteration step while incorporating a momentum term into the process. To facilitate fast convergence, we propose an adaptive strategy for selecting the step size and the momentum coefficient. Inspired by the spirit of the discrepancy principle, we introduce an {\it a posteriori} stopping rule for our adaptive stochastic heavy ball method.
